ClientResponses.Response:
Hello! Congratulations on your new grill! We are sorry to hear that you ran into some trouble on a few occasions. If you were to experience another gas flow issue in the future, as the agent mentioned, it could be due to a safety device built into the regulator. This safety device is a component of all LP gas regulators and is designed to reduce the flow of gas in the event of a leak.

To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF.
-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This amount of time should be enough to allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.
-Turn the 1st burner control knob to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.
-Turn the other burner control knob to high until lit.
-Close the grill lid.
-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

If you were still having trouble after following these steps, please reach out to us at support@weberstephen.com.

Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill and Lowe's offered free assembly so I opted for that. The first time I tried to light the grill it didn't light. A few days later I tried it again and it lit that time. This has happened several times and of course each time it didn't light was the time when I had family over to cook out. After the third and fourth occasion I called the Weber helpline. I was told that the regulator had to be reset and I was told to wait 2 minutes to push the ignitor. That worked but I'm curious why the manual says to wait 1 minute and my grill didn't light. Then I'm told to wait 2 minutes and it lights. The help desk and the manual are literally on two different pages. It's not the most expensive grill by far but it costs enough that I shouldn't be having issues with the ignitor system right out of the gate. The good news is that when it does light I do like the grill.

As others have stated the packing material will fill a recycle container. The good news because of the packing nothing is damaged and all the fasteners are included are well marked. 44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
